static: Accounts, shares and settings from the import replace the current ones.
All users must sign in again after the import: sessions, reset codes and the signing secret are cleared.
File locations are rebased to this server's data directory: copy each share folder to DATA_DIR/shares/<share id>/ for downloads to work.
Uploaded files are not part of a database backup; files on disk are not touched or restored.
